status_note: Thresholds are the RFP values as recorded in this repository (the RFP document itself is not in the repository: verify against RFP document). Interpretations, envelope states, coverage lists, the evidence-sufficiency policy and gates P1-P2 are PROPOSED for the owner (open_owner_decisions). Nothing here is a model result; no number is computed.
purpose: Hard pass/fail conditions that let a thrust architecture (hall_only, rf_hall, ecr_hall) be ELIMINATED early without subjective scoring. One gate per RFP requirement as recorded in the repository, plus clearly marked PROPOSED gates. Evaluated by abep_sim/hard_gates.py; explained in docs/architecture_comparison/hard_gates/HARD_GATES.md. No ranking and no winner.

A.name: conditional selection
A.definition: 'Architecture X is baseline provided conditions ... are demonstrated'. Does not require Physics Baseline 1.0.
A.this_matrix_provides: Elimination by binding gates on sufficient evidence (hard bounds, hardware measurements), and for every non-eliminated architecture the list of conditions (binding criteria not yet PASS) with the evidence that would discharge each one.
A.to_reach_next: B needs every binding gate PASS on verdict-bearing evidence: an admitted Hall transport closure (gate 3) with Vyovrinda design Hall maps per admitted member (docs/hallmap/), validated common-boundary models and ledgers (bus_power_boundary_v1), or Vyovrinda hardware measurements; and owner approval of this matrix.

B.name: physics-backed selection
B.definition: Credible envelopes from validated Hall transport, chemistry and common-boundary performance.
B.this_matrix_provides: PASS verdicts tagged with the milestone their evidence supports; admitted-closure evidence counts only as an envelope over every admitted member (unweighted scenario set).
B.to_reach_next: C needs one integrated design passing every binding gate, the owner's decision on every PROPOSED gate (adopt or waive), and every TBD threshold and open interpretation resolved.

C.name: proposal / PDR freeze
C.definition: Mass, power, thermal, life, startup, cathode and mission closure integrated on one design.
C.this_matrix_provides: The integration check: the set of designs that pass every binding gate at once, and the list of undecided owner items.
C.to_reach_next: Outside this matrix: hardware qualification of the frozen design.

architectures.hall_only: Common Hall accelerator without a separate pre-ionization stage.
architectures.rf_hall: RF pre-ionization stage feeding the common Hall accelerator.
architectures.ecr_hall: ECR pre-ionization stage feeding the common Hall accelerator.

common_boundary_note: The RF and ECR arms change only the pre-ionization method; the downstream Hall accelerator, feed state, cathode and bus boundary are common. Evidence names the architectures it applies to; an item naming all three is common evidence, and a FAIL on it applies to all three. Evidence is never transferred between architectures implicitly.

verdicts.PASS: Verdict-bearing evidence places the metric on the passing side of the threshold over the whole envelope, for one design (or of architecture scope), with no conflicting FAIL evidence.
verdicts.FAIL: Verdict-bearing evidence of ARCHITECTURE scope places the metric on the failing side over the part of the envelope the criterion requires (fail_must_cover). Point-design failures are recorded but never make the architecture FAIL.
verdicts.UNDETERMINED: Anything else: no evidence, insufficient evidence, incomplete coverage, a TBD threshold, or sufficient evidence on both sides (CONFLICT, owner review). Never read as PASS.

elimination_rule: An architecture is ELIMINATED only when a binding gate (status RFP or OWNER_ADOPTED) is FAIL. A gate is FAIL when any of its criteria with counts_for_fail = true is FAIL; counts_for_fail is true only when that FAIL holds under every open owner reading (its fail_must_cover spans every reading). A gate PASSES only when every criterion with counts_toward_gate = true passes for one design, and criteria that bind under only one open reading count toward PASS (conservative) but never FAIL the gate (fail_reading_dependence names the reading). So no elimination depends on an undecided owner reading. PROPOSED gates and non-counting criteria are evaluated and reported ('would eliminate if adopted') but never eliminate. A CONFLICT never eliminates.

evidence_policy.evidence_levels_ref: docs/EVIDENCE.md, 'Evidence hierarchy' (levels 1-7). Level describes the source; quantity type describes the number; they are orthogonal.
evidence_policy.weakest_input_rule: A value computed from several inputs takes the basis of its weakest input: a total that includes a load from an admitted Hall closure is model_admitted_closure; anything that uses an unadmitted closure is model_unadmitted_closure; anything resting on an assumption is assumption.

hard_physical_bound.description: A bound that follows from conservation laws or first principles, independent of any Hall transport closure, computed by a committed deterministic script whose own inputs are cited bounds or measurements. Example form (thrust): on a control surface far enough downstream that static pressure is negligible (so any pressure thrust is already converted into momentum flux), T = ∫v dm ≤ (∫dm · ∫v² dm)^½ = √(2·ṁ_tot·P_jet) (Cauchy–Schwarz), and energy conservation gives P_jet ≤ P_in + ṁ_tot·h0,inlet, where P_in bounds every non-feed power input to the gas (electrical power delivered to the flow, at most the total propulsion bus power, plus any heat input not supplied from the bus, stated by the script), h0,inlet bounds the specific stagnation enthalpy of every feed at the thruster inlet (upstream ICD thruster-inlet interface), and ṁ_tot bounds the TOTAL exhaust mass flow (atmospheric feed, cathode flow and any xenon feed). Hence T ≤ √(2·ṁ_tot,max·(P_in,max + ṁ_tot,max·h0,inlet,max)), and conversely P_in ≥ T²/(2·ṁ_tot,max) − ṁ_tot,max·h0,inlet,max. Precedent of this kind of elimination: CLAUDE.md 'magnetic nozzles excluded by energy per particle even at the energy bound' (mechanism-level).

measurement_vyovrinda.description: In-house measurement on Vyovrinda hardware (EVIDENCE.md level 1), stated as a bound that includes its uncertainty. A ground test must map its feed state to the envelope point (conditions.feed_equivalence, upstream ICD thruster-inlet interface) and state facility corrections in its transformation chain.

measurement_same_hardware.description: Independent measurement on the same or essentially identical hardware (EVIDENCE.md level 2), e.g. a supplier's measured mass or power of the exact part used, stated as a bound including uncertainty.

model_closure_independent.description: A model that uses no Hall transport closure (intake/compressor ROM, mass roll-up, power ledger, thermal network, wear model), declared validated for this use, run by a committed deterministic script, with its output stated as a bound.

model_admitted_closure.description: Design Hall maps on Vyovrinda geometry and B(z) (docs/hallmap/) produced by an ADMITTED transport-ensemble member (abep_sim/hall_ensemble.py require_admitted) at the pinned HallThruster.jl commit. Verdict-bearing only as an envelope over EVERY admitted member (unweighted scenario set); admission is the validation.

measurement_similar_hardware.reason: EVIDENCE.md level 3 on closely similar but different hardware: transfer to Vyovrinda hardware and flight conditions is uncertain. It can shape a condition or be a cited input to a hard bound; it is never a verdict by itself.

model_unadmitted_closure.reason: Screening candidates (sgb-screen-*) and any other unadmitted Hall transport closure are never performance sources (CLAUDE.md; P5-N₂ v1 left the credible set empty).

engineering_estimate.reason: EVIDENCE.md level 6: engineering correlation or extrapolation outside its validated domain, including a life extrapolated from a shorter test with an unvalidated wear model.

assumption.reason: EVIDENCE.md level 7: an assumption is never silently promoted to evidence.

value_kinds.lower_bound: the metric is at least value over the stated conditions
value_kinds.upper_bound: the metric is at most value over the stated conditions
value_kinds.interval: the metric lies in [lo, hi] over the stated conditions (its coverage stated in 'uncertainty')
value_kinds.point_estimate: a central value without a stated bound: recorded, never verdict-bearing
value_kinds.boolean: an established outcome for an is_true criterion (true: demonstrated; false: established impossible or observed to fail)

scopes.architecture: The bound or outcome holds for every admissible design of the architecture; scope_justification is required. Only architecture-scope FAIL evidence can make the architecture FAIL.
scopes.point_design: Holds for design_id only. A point-design FAIL is recorded as a design failure and never eliminates the architecture; point-design PASS evidence counts for that design.

comparators.>=: PASS if lower bound ≥ threshold; FAIL if upper bound < threshold
comparators.>: PASS if lower bound > threshold; FAIL if upper bound ≤ threshold
comparators.<: PASS if upper bound < threshold; FAIL if lower bound ≥ threshold
comparators.<=: PASS if upper bound ≤ threshold; FAIL if lower bound > threshold
comparators.is_true: PASS on an established true outcome; FAIL on an established false outcome

flags.hall_map_trustworthy: HallMap query 'trustworthy' (abep_sim/hall_map.py): every surrounding grid node converged and sustained, and chemistry_trustworthy.
flags.wall_life_trustworthy: HallMap query 'wall_life_trustworthy': trustworthy and solved with ion_wall_losses = true and the WallSheath model, unshielded (CLAUDE.md Next work 5).
flags.numerically_valid: Solver retcode success and finite state (hallthruster_bridge/prereg/p5_n2_run_status_rule_v1_addendum1_extinction.json).
flags.chemistry_trustworthy: No reaction activity beyond its rate table's validity limit (f_out ≤ 1e-12; CLAUDE.md Next work 5). OUT_OF_DOMAIN states are never evidence.
flags.mass_margin_free_lower_bound: G3 FAIL side: the value is a lower bound on the margin-free current-best-estimate mass sum (no growth allowance, no margin), so it bounds the mass from below under every recorded margin policy (OD7).
flags.mass_includes_max_margin_policy: G3 PASS side: the value is an upper bound on Σ CBE_i × (1 + max(MGA_i, 0.10)), which bounds both recorded margin policies (item-class MGA, abep_sim/mass_bom.py; '10 % margin', R3) from above (OD7).

coverage_dimensions.altitude_km: Closed altitude interval [low, high] in km over which the item's bound holds. Coverage is the union of items' intervals.
coverage_dimensions.atmosphere_states: Atmosphere/solar states. PROPOSED vocabulary: 'low', 'mean', 'high' = abep_sim/atmosphere.py solar states F10.7 70/150/230 (ap 15) on the frozen dataset atmosphere_msis21_v1 (OD3).
coverage_dimensions.operating_modes: 'startup', 'steady', 'peak': the modes of abep_sim/ppu.py ('startup (heater + compressor spin-up + keeper), steady, peak (Xe augmentation / solar max)').
coverage_dimensions.propellants: 'atmospheric' (the full composition delivered by the architecture's own upstream chain: N₂ + O + O₂ after wall recombination), 'xenon', 'atmospheric_xenon_mixed', 'n2_surrogate' (pure N₂: a partial surrogate that never covers 'atmospheric').
coverage_dimensions.start_sequences: 'air_only': a start from the off state that uses no xenon; 'xenon_assisted': any start that uses xenon at any point before the transition to the atmospheric feed (xenon-only ignition, xenon-seeded or mixed-feed start). The two are exhaustive: every start sequence either uses xenon or does not.
coverage_dimensions.elements: Architecture-specific element lists {'common': [...], '<architecture>': [...]}. elements_semantics 'sum': the metric is a sum over elements (a FAIL lower bound may use a subset of in-scope elements; a PASS bound must include all). 'per_element': every element must pass; any single element can fail.

calibration_nuisance_forbidden.rule: Layer-1 P5 calibration nuisance is marginalized when closures are admitted and is never a design variable, map axis, grid axis or trade dimension. Evidence carrying any of these keys is rejected with an error.

hall_closure_scope.rule: Hall transport-closure uncertainty belongs only to the ionization/discharge → acceleration/thrust block. It must never leak upstream into the intake, filter, compressor, gas chambers or valves, or into Vyovrinda's own thruster geometry.
hall_closure_scope.source: CLAUDE.md Next work 1, 'Scope'; the RFP architecture blocks as recorded (R4)
hall_closure_scope.per_element_criteria: On a per_element criterion (G4, G5, P1) an item with hall_closure.status 'admitted' or 'unadmitted' that names any of these elements is rejected with an error. Their firing life, calendar capability and temperature are evaluated at the architecture's DECLARED feed flows, duty cycle and mission profile (design inputs), so they do not depend on the Hall closure; whether that profile delivers the required thrust is decided by G1 and G7, not through these elements.
hall_closure_scope.sum_criteria: On a sum criterion (G2 bus power) an upstream load (compressor, flow_control) may appear in a total that also contains a closure-dependent load; the total then takes the admitted-closure basis (weakest-input rule), while the upstream load's own value must come from closure-independent inputs at the declared feed flow. G3 mass is closure-independent as a whole (Hall-closure evidence on it is rejected).

gates.title: Thrust 12–25 mN over the 180–230 km envelope

rfp_source.section_as_recorded: Part III Para 2 (per the abep_sim/constants.py docstring)

criteria.title: Sustained thrust on atmospheric propellant ≥ 12 mN at every envelope point, within the bus-power limit
criteria.definition: Largest steady thrust the architecture sustains on the feed named in the evidence's conditions.propellants (for PASS: the atmospheric feed alone, i.e. the gas its own intake → filter → compressor → atmospheric gas chamber → valve chain delivers at that altitude and atmosphere state), with total propulsion bus power at bus_power_boundary_v1 below the G2 limit. Vacuum-equivalent axial thrust; facility corrections are stated in the evidence's transformation chain.
criteria.threshold_source: lower edge of '12–25 mN' (R1; R2 thrust_min_mN). Verify against RFP document.
criteria.interpretation: Binds under both readings of '12–25 mN' (OD1). Whether the 12 mN floor must be met on atmospheric propellant alone (repository reading: R3 '12 mN sustained on air'; abep_sim/system.py check thrust_air_ge_req) or with Xe augmentation is OD4: PASS needs the atmospheric feed alone (holds under both readings), and FAIL needs an upper bound that holds on the atmospheric feed alone AND with Xe augmentation (propellants atmospheric and atmospheric_xenon_mixed, modes steady and peak), so it fails under both readings. Envelope quantifier OD2: PASS and FAIL must both cover every envelope point.
criteria.envelope_source: altitude: RFP as recorded (R1, R2). atmosphere_states: PROPOSED (OD3). operating_modes, propellants: this criterion's definition.
criteria.fail_evidence: Upper bounds < 12 mN of architecture scope covering every altitude × atmosphere-state point, holding on the atmospheric feed alone AND with Xe augmentation in steady and peak modes (OD4): a closure-independent momentum/energy bound (T ≤ √(2·ṁ_tot,max·(P_in,max + ṁ_tot,max·h0,inlet,max)), evidence_policy.bases.hard_physical_bound, with ṁ_tot,max bounding the TOTAL exhaust mass flow including cathode flow and any Xe augmentation, h0,inlet,max the feed stagnation enthalpy at the thruster inlet from the upstream ICD, and P_in,max at most the G2 limit plus any stated non-bus heat input), Vyovrinda or same-hardware measurements with a scope justification, or trustworthy Hall maps of EVERY admitted closure. Never: screening-candidate or other unadmitted-closure results, point estimates, literature on similar hardware, assumptions.
criteria.pass_evidence: Lower bounds ≥ 12 mN covering every altitude × atmosphere-state point for one design (or of architecture scope): Vyovrinda or same-hardware measurements with the feed state mapped to the envelope point and power stated at bus_power_boundary_v1, or trustworthy Hall maps (Vyovrinda geometry and B(z)) of every admitted closure.

criteria.title: Thrust can be held at or below 25 mN (reading (i) of '12–25 mN'; counts toward PASS only until OD1)
criteria.fail_reading_dependence: OD1: binds only under reading (i), 25 mN as the upper edge of an operating window. Under reading (ii) (12 mN sustained floor plus 25 mN peak capability) a minimum stable thrust above 25 mN still complies, so its FAIL never makes G1 FAIL until the owner decides OD1.
criteria.definition: Smallest steady thrust at which the architecture operates stably on atmospheric propellant at the envelope point (the low end of its throttle range).
criteria.threshold_source: upper edge of '12–25 mN' (R1; R2 thrust_max_mN). Verify against RFP document.
criteria.interpretation: Reading (i) of '12–25 mN' (OD1): the delivered thrust must be able to lie in the [12, 25] mN window, so an architecture whose minimum stable thrust exceeds 25 mN everywhere does not comply under that reading. It counts toward PASS (a PASS must hold under both readings) but its FAIL is reported only (fail_reading_dependence). Whole-envelope coverage for both verdicts while OD2 is open.
criteria.fail_evidence: Lower bounds > 25 mN on the minimum stable thrust, of architecture scope, over every envelope point (same bases as G1.thrust_floor).
criteria.pass_evidence: Upper bounds ≤ 25 mN on the minimum stable thrust over every envelope point for one design.

criteria.title: 25 mN peak capability with Xe augmentation (reading (ii) of '12–25 mN'; counts toward PASS only until OD1)
criteria.fail_reading_dependence: OD1: binds only under reading (ii), a 25 mN peak capability with Xe (R3 '25 mN peak with Xe topping'). Under reading (i) 25 mN is a cap, not a capability requirement.
criteria.definition: Largest thrust the architecture delivers at the envelope point with the Xe feed allowed to augment the atmospheric feed, within the G2 limit.
criteria.threshold_source: '12–25 mN' (R1, R2) read as a 25 mN peak requirement, as abep_sim/system.py does (check thrust_peak_25mN) and R3 states ('25 mN peak with Xe topping'). Verify against RFP document.
criteria.interpretation: Reading (ii). Reading (i) treats 25 mN as the upper edge of the operating window (docs/HISTORY.md mission sections: 'the RFP's 25 mN cap'). Counts toward PASS (a PASS must hold under both readings) but its FAIL never makes G1 FAIL until the owner decides OD1.
criteria.envelope_source: as G1.thrust_floor; mode and propellant from reading (ii).
criteria.fail_evidence: Upper bounds < 25 mN on the peak thrust over every envelope point, of architecture scope.
criteria.pass_evidence: Lower bounds ≥ 25 mN on the peak thrust over every envelope point for one design.

gates.notes: Hall-closure dependent. Open readings: envelope quantifier OD2, '12–25 mN' OD1, floor with or without Xe OD4. Only G1.thrust_floor can FAIL the gate, and only with a bound that holds under every one of those readings; the ceiling and the peak capability count toward PASS only.

gates.title: Bus power < 1.5 kW at the common DC boundary (bus_power_boundary_v1)

rfp_source.section_as_recorded: Part III Para 2 (per the abep_sim/constants.py docstring)

criteria.title: Total propulsion bus power below 1500 W in every operating mode
criteria.definition: Largest total power drawn from the spacecraft bus by the propulsion system over the startup, steady and peak modes, at operating points that meet G1.thrust_floor: the sum over every bus_power_boundary_v1 component of the architecture of load / converter efficiency, as ledger(arch, loads, efficiencies) of abep_sim/arch_boundary.py computes it.
criteria.threshold_source: '< 1.5 kW' (R1); power_max_W 1500 (R2); '< 1500 W total' (R3). Verify against RFP document.
criteria.interpretation: Loads are non-negative, so a lower bound on a subset of components bounds the total from below (FAIL); a PASS bound must include every component of the architecture. Open readings: power-limit scope OD8 (every mode vs steady only) and floor with or without Xe OD4. PASS must hold in every mode (startup, steady, peak) and on both the atmospheric and the Xe-augmented feed; FAIL needs a lower bound that holds in STEADY mode on the atmospheric feed AND with Xe augmentation, which exceeds the limit under every reading. A bound shown only for startup or peak is reported but never a FAIL.
criteria.envelope_source: altitude: RFP (R1, R2). atmosphere_states: PROPOSED (OD3). operating_modes: PROPOSED, the modes of abep_sim/ppu.py. elements: the bus_power_boundary_v1 component set (power_boundary.components).
criteria.fail_evidence: Lower bounds ≥ 1500 W of architecture scope at every altitude × atmosphere-state point, in steady mode, on the atmospheric feed and with Xe augmentation (OD8, OD4): e.g. the energy bound P_in ≥ T²/(2·ṁ_tot,max) − ṁ_tot,max·h0,inlet,max at T = 12 mN (evidence_policy.bases.hard_physical_bound; ṁ_tot,max bounds the total exhaust mass flow including cathode flow and any Xe augmentation, h0,inlet,max the feed stagnation enthalpy at the thruster inlet, and any non-bus heat input is subtracted as a stated bound) plus lower bounds on other in-scope loads, measured component loads, or trustworthy Hall maps of every admitted closure for hall_discharge. model_closure_independent applies only to totals none of whose components depends on the Hall closure (weakest-input rule).
criteria.pass_evidence: Upper bounds < 1500 W on the complete bus_power_boundary_v1 ledger (every component of the architecture) for every mode, feed and envelope point, for one design.

gates.notes: The common DC boundary makes the three architectures comparable: power that a pre-ionizer adds appears as rf_source or ecr_source/ecr_magnet loads on the same ledger.

rfp_source.section_as_recorded: Part III Para 2 (per the abep_sim/constants.py docstring)

criteria.title: Maximum expected mass below 40 kg
criteria.definition: Propulsion-system mass: Σ over every in-scope mass item of CBE × (1 + margin), including the mission xenon load and its tank. The limit's form (strict or inclusive) and the margin policy are open (OD7), so the two verdicts use bounding quantities: PASS needs an upper bound on Σ CBE_i × (1 + max(MGA_i, 0.10)) (flag mass_includes_max_margin_policy), which bounds the mass under both recorded policies; FAIL needs a lower bound on the margin-free Σ CBE (flag mass_margin_free_lower_bound), which bounds it from below under every policy; the CBE of a subset of in-scope items bounds the total from below.
criteria.threshold_source: '< 40 kg' (R1); mass_max_kg 40 (R2); '< 40 kg total incl. intake, compressor, PSE, Xe + tank, structure, 10 % margin' (R3). Verify against RFP document.
criteria.interpretation: OD7: strict '<' per the RFP summary R1 vs '<=' in repository code (abep_sim/system.py); '10 % margin' (R3) vs item-class MGA (abep_sim/mass_bom.py). A bound exactly at 40 kg decides neither verdict (threshold_equality_open), PASS uses the larger margin, FAIL the margin-free mass: no verdict depends on OD7. The mass of a given design is independent of the Hall transport closure, and the mission xenon load is the design's DECLARED xenon allocation (a design input; whether it lasts the mission at the declared Xe duty is G5), so closure evidence is rejected here; a xenon load sized from Hall-closure Xe-mode performance is not accepted.
criteria.envelope_source: elements: PROPOSED mass-item breakdown (OD10) following the RFP architecture blocks as recorded (R4), the R3 inclusion list and the bus_power_boundary_v1 components.
criteria.fail_evidence: A lower bound > 40 kg on the margin-free CBE sum, of architecture scope: e.g. Σ CBE of in-scope items whose minimum mass is fixed by physics, or by measured / supplier-measured masses of the only parts available, with a scope justification that no design of the architecture avoids them.
criteria.pass_evidence: An upper bound < 40 kg on Σ CBE_i × (1 + max(MGA_i, 0.10)) of one design that includes every in-scope item.

gates.title: Firing life > 15,000 h

rfp_source.section_as_recorded: Part III Para 2 (per the abep_sim/constants.py docstring)

criteria.title: Every firing-time-limited element survives more than 15,000 h of firing
criteria.definition: Cumulative firing (thruster-on) time each firing-time-limited element survives before losing its function (e.g. Hall channel wall erosion to its design limit, cathode insert/keeper wear, pre-ionizer source wear), at the architecture's declared mission firing profile and propellant mix (atmospheric species including atomic O).
criteria.threshold_source: '> 15,000 h firing' (R1); ignition_hours 15000 with comment '">15,000 h"' (R2); the repository records the RFP wording as '>15,000 h ignition' (R3, R5). Verify against RFP document.
criteria.interpretation: 'Ignition hours' in the recorded RFP wording is read as cumulative firing time, not a restart count (OD13; R1 records '> 15,000 h firing'). Every element must exceed 15,000 h; a FAIL of any one element suffices. Hall-closure evidence is accepted only for elements of the ionization/discharge → acceleration/thrust block; for the upstream elements (hall_closure_scope: compressor, valves_and_flow_control) it is rejected, since their firing life is evaluated at the declared feed flow and firing profile.
criteria.fail_evidence: An upper bound ≤ 15,000 h on any one element, of architecture scope (the life-limiting mechanism is intrinsic to the architecture, not to one design). A life extrapolated from a shorter test is an engineering_estimate unless the wear model is validated for this use.
criteria.pass_evidence: Lower bounds > 15,000 h for every element of one design: full-duration tests, validated wear models (closure-independent elements), or wall erosion from Hall maps that are wall_life_trustworthy for every admitted closure.

gates.notes: Wall erosion needs wall_life_trustworthy maps (ion_wall_losses = true, WallSheath, unshielded).

gates.title: Mission duration 26,000 h

rfp_source.section_as_recorded: Part III Para 2 (per the abep_sim/constants.py docstring)

criteria.title: Every element keeps its function for the 26,000 h mission
criteria.definition: Calendar time in orbit over which each element keeps its function under calendar-time degradation (e.g. atomic-oxygen fluence on intake, filter and compressor surfaces; consumable depletion, xenon at the declared duty cycle; storage and idle degradation) together with the firing time it accrues (G4), at the architecture's declared mission profile.
criteria.threshold_source: '26,000 h mission' (R1); mission_hours 26000, '3 years' (R2); R3, R5. Verify against RFP document.
criteria.interpretation: Read as a capability of the propulsion system to remain functional for the whole mission. It is not a drag-compensation requirement (see not_gates). The upstream elements (hall_closure_scope: intake, filter, compressor, gas chambers including the xenon load, valves) are evaluated at the architecture's DECLARED feed flows, xenon duty cycle and mission profile, so Hall-closure evidence on them is rejected; whether that profile delivers the thrust is G1 and G7.
criteria.envelope_source: elements: PROPOSED calendar-life element list (OD10) following the RFP architecture blocks as recorded (R4).
criteria.fail_evidence: An upper bound < 26,000 h on any one element, of architecture scope (e.g. a consumable whose required mass cannot fit the architecture at any design, bounded from below by physics).
criteria.pass_evidence: Lower bounds ≥ 26,000 h for every element of one design.

gates.notes: The AO-beam test recorded as RFP 4.1a (R6) supplies G5 evidence for AO-exposed surfaces.

gates.title: Ignition and sustainment on atmospheric propellant

rfp_source.text_as_recorded: air + Xe (R1); N₂ + nascent O and 'ionise nascent O' (R3, R6); the atmospheric path feeds the ionization/discharge block (R4)
rfp_source.verify: verify against RFP document — no ignition/restart clause is recorded in the repository; the EXISTENCE of G6.ignition as a requirement is INFERRED (from 'air + Xe', R1, and the atmospheric path feeding the discharge, R4), not recorded RFP text (OD14)

criteria.title: Steady discharge sustained on the delivered atmospheric feed at every envelope point
criteria.definition: The discharge sustains in steady state (no extinction) on the atmospheric feed delivered by the architecture's own upstream chain at the envelope point (composition N₂ + O + O₂ after wall recombination; flow and pressure per the upstream ICD thruster-inlet interface).
criteria.interpretation: 'Atmospheric propellant' is the full delivered composition; pure-N₂ evidence ('n2_surrogate') covers it for neither verdict. Hall-map extinction is FAIL-side evidence only if numerically valid and chemistry-trustworthy (p5_n2_run_status_rule_v1 addendum 1); OUT_OF_DOMAIN states are never evidence. Whole-envelope coverage for both verdicts while OD2 is open.
criteria.fail_evidence: Established non-sustainment of architecture scope at every envelope point: a closure-independent bound (e.g. the deliverable feed cannot support the ionization balance at any design), Vyovrinda / same-hardware measurements with a scope justification, or numerically valid, chemistry-trustworthy extinction in every admitted closure.
criteria.pass_evidence: Demonstrated steady sustainment at every envelope point for one design: Vyovrinda or same-hardware tests with the feed mapped to the envelope point, or trustworthy Hall maps of every admitted closure.

criteria.title: Ignition from the off state into a sustained discharge on atmospheric propellant
criteria.definition: From the off state, the architecture's declared start sequence establishes a sustained discharge on atmospheric propellant at the envelope feed conditions.
criteria.interpretation: The requirement's existence is inferred, not recorded RFP text (OD14). Whether a xenon-assisted start counts is open (OD5). While open: PASS needs an air-only start; FAIL must exclude both air-only and xenon-assisted starts. The two start sequences are exhaustive (coverage_dimensions.start_sequences), so a FAIL means no start sequence at all brings the architecture into a sustained discharge on atmospheric propellant, i.e. it cannot operate on the recorded 'air' propellant (R1) whatever the RFP says about ignition; the FAIL therefore holds under both OD5 and OD14. Steady-state Hall maps carry no breakdown or ignition physics, so no Hall-closure model result is accepted (docs/HISTORY.md 'Hall ignition (item 5)': the breadboard ignition-vs-flow curve 'is the highest-value measurement left in the Hall decision').
criteria.envelope_source: altitude: RFP (R1, R2). atmosphere_states: PROPOSED (OD3). start_sequences: OD5.
criteria.fail_evidence: Established inability to ignite, of architecture scope, at every envelope point for both air-only and xenon-assisted starts (hard bound, or measurements with a scope justification).
criteria.pass_evidence: Demonstrated air-only ignition at every envelope point (feed mapped to the envelope point) for one design.

criteria.title: Number of ignitions over the mission (threshold TBD)
criteria.definition: Number of successful ignitions (G6.ignition) the architecture sustains over its life.
criteria.threshold_source: TBD — requires the RFP restart/ignition clause (none recorded in the repository; verify against RFP document) or an owner-defined operations concept. abep_sim/system.py uses cathode_starts = mission_hours/24 × 0.5, a modelling assumption, not a requirement.
criteria.interpretation: Not counted toward G6 (neither PASS nor FAIL) until a threshold exists (OD5, OD14); listed as an open owner item that blocks milestone C.

gates.notes: RF/ECR pre-ionization is expected to matter most here; evidence comes from the common-condition experiment protocol and the sustainment evidence matrices.

gates.title: Air + Xe operation

rfp_source.text_as_recorded: air + Xe (R1); Xe as propellant (R3); the Xe path (Xe chamber → valve) feeds the ionization/discharge block (R4)

criteria.title: Steady operation with thrust on the Xe feed path within the bus-power limit
criteria.definition: The architecture sustains a steady discharge producing thrust on the Xe feed path (Xe chamber → valve → ionization/discharge) within the G2 limit at bus_power_boundary_v1.
criteria.interpretation: The thruster is read as having to operate on each RFP propellant. Operation on the atmospheric feed is gated by G1.thrust_floor and G6.sustainment, so G7 adds the Xe path. The meaning of 'air + Xe' is open (OD6: each feed separately, feed switching, simultaneous mixed feed). PASS needs steady operation on the Xe feed; FAIL needs established inability on EVERY xenon-containing feed (xenon and atmospheric_xenon_mixed, steady and peak modes), which fails every OD6 reading. G7.feed_switching and G7.mixed_feed count toward PASS only.
criteria.fail_evidence: Established inability to sustain on any xenon-containing feed (xenon alone and atmospheric + xenon mixed, steady and peak modes) within the power limit, of architecture scope.
criteria.pass_evidence: Demonstrated steady Xe operation with thrust within the power limit for one design.

criteria.title: Change between atmospheric and Xe feed without losing the discharge (counts toward PASS only until OD6)
criteria.fail_reading_dependence: OD6: binds only under the 'feed switching' reading of 'air + Xe'.
criteria.definition: The architecture changes between the atmospheric and the Xe feed without losing the discharge.
criteria.interpretation: One reading of 'air + Xe' (OD6). Counts toward PASS (a PASS must hold under every reading) but its FAIL never makes G7 FAIL until the owner decides.
criteria.fail_evidence: Established loss of discharge on every switchover, of architecture scope.
criteria.pass_evidence: Demonstrated switchovers without extinction at every envelope point for one design.

criteria.title: Simultaneous atmospheric + Xe operation (counts toward PASS only until OD6)
criteria.fail_reading_dependence: OD6: binds only under the 'simultaneous mixed feed' reading of 'air + Xe' (linked to reading (ii) of OD1).
criteria.definition: Steady operation with the atmospheric and Xe feeds open simultaneously (e.g. Xe augmentation; docs/HISTORY.md 'Xe anode topping').
criteria.interpretation: One reading of 'air + Xe' (OD6), linked to reading (ii) of '12–25 mN' (OD1). Counts toward PASS (a PASS must hold under every reading) but its FAIL never makes G7 FAIL until the owner decides.
criteria.fail_evidence: Established inability to sustain on the mixed feed at every envelope point, of architecture scope.
criteria.pass_evidence: Demonstrated mixed-feed operation at every envelope point for one design.

gates.notes: Hall-closure dependent. Open reading OD6: G7.xenon_operation can FAIL the gate only with evidence covering every xenon-containing feed; feed switching and mixed feed count toward PASS only.

gates.title: Thermal feasibility (PROPOSED)

proposal.proposed_by: project owner's example in the lane brief ('e.g. thermal feasibility, cathode life'); criteria drafted by this lane
proposal.rationale: Milestone C integrates thermal closure; an element above its allowable temperature at the operating point is a hard infeasibility the recorded RFP summary does not state.
proposal.owner_decision: adopt (status OWNER_ADOPTED, binding) or waive; allowable temperatures, thermal cases and any acceptance margin are TBD (OD9)

criteria.title: Every thermally limited element stays at or below its allowable temperature
criteria.definition: For each thermally limited element: its allowable temperature (from its own qualification or datasheet data) minus its steady temperature at the architecture's operating point, in the worst thermal case the evidence declares (hot and cold cases TBD with abep_sim/thermal_life.py).
criteria.threshold_source: PROPOSED: zero margin against each element's allowable temperature; any required acceptance margin is an owner decision (OD9).
criteria.interpretation: Heat loads that come from the Hall discharge make this closure-dependent for the discharge-block elements (weakest-input rule). For the upstream elements (hall_closure_scope: compressor, valves_and_flow_control) Hall-closure evidence is rejected; their temperature is evaluated at the declared feed flow.
criteria.envelope_source: PROPOSED element list (OD10); modes from abep_sim/ppu.py.
criteria.fail_evidence: An upper bound < 0 K on the margin of any element, of architecture scope.
criteria.pass_evidence: Lower bounds ≥ 0 K for every element and mode of one design.

gates.notes: PROPOSED: evaluated and reported, never eliminates until adopted.

gates.title: Cathode life and start cycles (PROPOSED)

proposal.proposed_by: project owner's example in the lane brief ('e.g. thermal feasibility, cathode life'); criteria drafted by this lane
proposal.rationale: The cathode is a common element but its emission current and gas environment depend on the architecture's operating point, and it carries the start cycles; a dedicated gate keeps it tracked against the cathode evidence matrix. The cathode is also a G4 element, so its firing life already binds through G4.
proposal.owner_decision: adopt (status OWNER_ADOPTED, binding) or waive; the start-cycle threshold is TBD (OD5, OD9)

criteria.title: Cathode firing life above 15,000 h at this architecture's cathode operating point
criteria.definition: Firing life of the cathode (emitter, keeper, heater) at this architecture's emission current, gas feed and exposure (including back-streaming atmospheric species).
criteria.threshold_source: the RFP firing-life threshold of G4 ('> 15,000 h', R1, R2) applied to the cathode. Verify against RFP document.
criteria.interpretation: PROPOSED dedicated gate; the same threshold already binds through G4.firing_life (element 'cathode').
criteria.fail_evidence: An upper bound ≤ 15,000 h, of architecture scope.
criteria.pass_evidence: A lower bound > 15,000 h for one design.

criteria.title: Cathode start cycles (threshold TBD)
criteria.definition: Number of cathode starts (heater + ignition cycles) the cathode survives.
criteria.threshold_source: TBD — requires the restart count (G6.restart_count, OD5).
criteria.interpretation: Counts toward the PROPOSED gate, so P2 cannot PASS until the threshold exists.

gates.notes: PROPOSED: evaluated and reported, never eliminates until adopted.

rfp_requirements_recorded_not_gated.requirement: Indigenous content ≥ 75 % total; subsystem minima thruster 0.80, intake 0.80, compressor 0.60, PSE 0.70
rfp_requirements_recorded_not_gated.reason: Programmatic sourcing requirement; docs/EVIDENCE.md defines no evidence class for it, and repository code already separates it from technical closure (docs/HISTORY.md v0.3.1 technical_compliant). Not encoded as an elimination gate in v1 — owner decision OD12. Verify against RFP document.
Design-implementation requirement; its mass and power consequences are carried by G2 and G3 (redundant units in the ledgers). Owner decision OD12. Verify against RFP document.
A test requirement, not a performance limit; it supplies G5 evidence for AO-exposed surfaces.
Carried through the definition of 'atmospheric propellant' in G1 and G6 (the delivered composition includes O); no threshold is recorded. Owner decision OD12 whether it needs its own gate.

not_gates.reason: A preference, not a pass/fail limit. All three architectures use the same downstream Hall accelerator, so it cannot discriminate between them.

not_gates.item: Net drag compensation on air (T ≥ D)
not_gates.source: R3: 'the RFP does not state it'
not_gates.reason: Not an RFP requirement as recorded, and the spacecraft drag is not specified. It can enter only as an owner-PROPOSED gate.

A comparative, mechanism-level finding, not an RFP limit: an architecture that adds nothing over hall_only still passes or fails the same gates. It can never eliminate rf_hall or ecr_hall through this matrix.

not_gates.item: Any absolute Hall result from the withdrawn 0-D closure (v1.2-v1.6)
not_gates.reason: Withdrawn; never evidence for any gate.

options: (i) operating window: delivered thrust within [12, 25] mN (25 mN as a cap)
(ii) 12 mN sustained floor plus 25 mN peak capability with Xe (abep_sim/system.py)
open_owner_decisions.current_handling: G1.thrust_floor binds under both readings (counts for PASS and FAIL). G1.thrust_ceiling (reading (i)) and G1.peak_capability_25mN (reading (ii)) both count toward PASS, so a PASS holds under either reading, but neither can FAIL G1 (counts_for_fail false) until the owner decides.

open_owner_decisions.topic: Envelope quantifier over 180–230 km × atmosphere states
options: some operating altitude in the band
open_owner_decisions.current_handling: PASS must cover every point AND FAIL must cover every point, so no verdict depends on the open reading.

options: PROPOSED: 'low', 'mean', 'high' (F10.7 70/150/230, ap 15; frozen atmosphere_msis21_v1 via abep_sim/atmosphere.py)

open_owner_decisions.topic: 12 mN floor on atmospheric propellant alone vs with Xe
open_owner_decisions.current_handling: PASS on the atmospheric feed alone (holds under both readings). FAIL on G1.thrust_floor and G2 needs a bound that holds on the atmospheric feed alone AND with Xe augmentation (fail_must_cover propellants atmospheric and atmospheric_xenon_mixed), so it holds under both readings.

open_owner_decisions.topic: Ignition start sequence and restart count
open_owner_decisions.current_handling: PASS needs an air-only start; FAIL must exclude both start sequences, which are exhaustive (with or without xenon); the restart count is TBD and not counted (G6.restart_count, P2.start_cycles).

G7.xenon_operation counts for PASS and FAIL; its FAIL must cover every xenon-containing feed (xenon and atmospheric_xenon_mixed, steady and peak), so it holds under each reading. G7.feed_switching and G7.mixed_feed count toward PASS only.

open_owner_decisions.topic: Mass limit form and margin policy
open_owner_decisions.current_handling: No verdict depends on it: PASS needs an upper bound < 40 kg on Σ CBE × (1 + max(MGA, 10 %)); FAIL needs a lower bound > 40 kg on the margin-free CBE sum; a bound exactly at 40 kg decides nothing (threshold_equality_open).

options: total propulsion bus power at the common DC boundary in every mode
open_owner_decisions.current_handling: PASS must hold in every mode (startup, steady, peak); FAIL needs a lower bound that holds in steady mode (fail_must_cover), which exceeds the limit under both readings. A startup- or peak-only bound never FAILs.

open_owner_decisions.topic: PROPOSED gates P1 thermal and P2 cathode
open_owner_decisions.current_handling: reported, never eliminate; allowables, thermal cases, margins and start-cycle count TBD.

open_owner_decisions.topic: PROPOSED element lists (mass items, life-limited, calendar-life, thermal elements)
open_owner_decisions.current_handling: PROPOSED lists used for PASS and FAIL coverage; an amendment is a new matrix version and every verdict is re-evaluated.

open_owner_decisions.current_handling: outside the matrix, listed in rfp_requirements_recorded_not_gated.

options: something else in the RFP text

open_owner_decisions.topic: Is ignition from the off state on atmospheric propellant an RFP requirement? (G6.ignition is inferred from 'air + Xe' and the RFP architecture; no ignition or restart clause is recorded in the repository)
options: the RFP text states an ignition/restart clause (verify against RFP document)
drop G6.ignition as a separate criterion
open_owner_decisions.current_handling: binding. Its FAIL needs every start sequence (air-only and xenon-assisted, exhaustive) excluded, which means the architecture cannot operate on atmospheric propellant at all, so the FAIL does not depend on this decision; its PASS (air-only start) is the conservative side.
